headline: Car Strikes Ten at Newcastle Knights Send-Off
deck: A car struck ten people, including three children, waiting to farewell the Newcastle Knights. A five-year-old girl and a 67-year-old man are critical.
body: An 18-year-old provisional driver has been arrested after a car struck ten people, including three children, waiting in Newcastle to farewell the Knights ahead of Sunday's NRL grand final. [E1]
A girl aged five and a man aged 67 are in critical condition after the strike near Wallsend. [E2]
